## Route Recompute (free lead-quality upgrade)

`POST /webhook/route-recompute`  -> **dry run**, reports what would change, writes nothing
`POST /webhook/route-recompute {"apply":true}` -> commits

**Why it exists:** Template Route is derived ONLY from columns already in the sheet (Priority,
Competitor Reviews, Review Count, Top Complaint, Best Review Quote). So when the routing RULE
changes - as it did with Lever 3 (P2 + gap>=30 qualifies for A-lite) and Lever 4 (wider complaint
keywords) - existing rows can be upgraded with **no Apify and no Claude spend**.

**Safety:** writes ONLY the two adjacent route columns (T:U), so it cannot touch the Claude fields
and is immune to HAZARD-1. Aborts if those two columns are ever not adjacent.

Keep the rule in this node in lockstep with `computeTemplateRoute()` in the CHILD's Build CRM Row.
